title: after - Parameters
text_content: A callback function which will be executed after the response (or prerender) is finished.

title: after - Duration
text_content: `` will run for the platform's default or configured max duration of your route. If your platform supports it, you can configure the timeout limit using the [/docs/app/api-reference/file-conventions/route-segment-config#maxduration](/docs/app/api-reference/file-conventions/route-segment-config#maxduration) route segment config.

title: after - Alternatives
text_content:
The use case for `` is to process secondary tasks without blocking the primary response. It's similar to using the platform's [https://vercel.com/docs/functions/functions-api-reference](https://vercel.com/docs/functions/functions-api-reference) or removing `` from a promise, but with the following differences:
``: accepts a promise and enqueues a task to be executed during the lifecycle of the request, whereas `` accepts a callback that will be executed after the response is finished.
Removing ``: starts executing during the response, which uses resources. It's also not reliable in serverless environments as the function stops computation immediately after the response is sent, potentially interrupting the task.
We recommend using `` as it has been designed to consider other Next.js APIs and contexts.
